title: Trailer
when: Launches, announcements, teasers and any film whose job is anticipation rather than explanation

voice.style: deep, deliberate trailer read: short lines, weight on the last word

rules: Three acts: a cold open (sketch void), a rising montage of 2–4 s shots split by black type cards, a silence, the title (sketch title), then a button.
Type cards are white on black with wide tracking and one short phrase each. Use tone invert or canvas text, never a heading.
Cut on action and on the music; each montage shot is shorter than the last as the title approaches.
Before the title, one beat with no voice and a single element: the silence makes the hit land.
End on a button: one short line after the title, like a release date.
